open_rule: Only sources with open == 'yes' are fetched by default and only they reach normalised/. FULLY OPEN means OGL v3, CC BY, CC0, public domain or ODbL with attribution; non-commercial, approval-based and paid sources are 'no'. 'unverified' means nobody has yet quoted the licence that applies to the exact file.
